description.value:
Frequency once per round, separate from Flash Mob

Requirements One of Blaster's living Flash Mob thralls is within 60 feet.

Effect The thrall emits one 60-foot aura for only its summoning Blaster until the start of his next turn.

  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraIns01]{Inspire} +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear while within 60 feet.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraGrd01]{Guard} +1 status bonus to AC while within 60 feet.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster} 10 temporary HP, retained on exit without refilling on re-entry. Higher existing temporary HP retain their original duration; only Bolster-granted HP expire with this aura.

The thrall gains no movement or other actions. Its destruction ends the aura and benefits.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterMobCmd001]{Command Thrall}
